locations.name: Ashwick
locations.description: Grain fields, cheap provisions, and the southern contract board.

locations.name: Blackwater Ford
locations.description: A narrow river crossing. Hold the ground before the raiders do.

locations.name: Stonecross
locations.description: A fortified market. The watch pays well for dangerous work.

locations.name: Brackenwood
locations.description: Raiders shelter beneath the trees. Break their entire band.

locations.name: Dunmere
locations.description: A lakeside settlement with hunters and worn-out soldiers for hire.

locations.name: Cairn Ridge
locations.description: Hold the high banner until a relief column reaches the ridge.
